skills.name: playwright-test-generator
skills.description: Generate Playwright tests when user asks for testcases
skills.prompt: Before generating, follow rules defined in: .claude/agents/playwright-agent.md and app-config.md. Then generate a complete Playwright test using POM, proper locators, assertions, and project conventions.

skills.name: playwright-test-healer
skills.description: Trigger when user mentions failing test, error, or fix test
skills.prompt: Follow the test-healer workflow defined in .claude/agents/test-healer.md. Diagnose failure, identify root cause, fix in correct layer (locator/page/testdata), and explain changes.
